messages:
sam: Quick follow-up from the all-hands 1: a bunch of AEs asked for crisp rules on trials -> pipeline status and partner pilot details.
sam: TL;DR asks: 1) classification rule for inbound trials (POC vs opp), 2) partner co-sell economics + registration flow, 3) Dedicated vs Hosted decision tree and one-pager for AEs/SEs.
leila: For funnel hygiene: mark inbound trial as POC until signed PO or subscription activated. If legal review/subscription in progress but no PO, still POC.
leila: Add a custom field "POC expected close" on SFDC so we can track conversion lag.
owen: Partner pilot: legal okayed a 12-week pilot with registered partners only. Co-sell credit = 10% of net software revenue, capped per deal for pilot.
owen: Registration process: partner fills registration form -> Partner Ops approves -> deal reg number issued. Use the new form in #partners (link: https://redwood.co/partners/register).
marco: Who owns the partner credit accounting? Finance or Sales Ops?
leila: Sales Ops owns the quote template and credit calculation; Finance will audit monthly. Sales Ops to create a simple calc sheet for AEs.
tara: On Dedicated vs Hosted: product recommends Hosted for evaluation and early production. Dedicated when: data residency, guaranteed throughput, or bespoke model pinning needed.
tara: I'll drop a decision tree and two-slide one-pager (signals and suggested approach) by Thurs.
kira: SE ask: can we get a migration runbook stub? expected lead times, infra reqs, and sample terraform snippet.
marco: Yes please. SEs need a checklist we can hand to customers during QBRs.
owen: Also adding a terraform snippet example to repo: https://git.redwood.co/infra/dedicated-examples
sam: For partner outreach AEs asked for a 1-line pitch and a short battlecard. Can someone draft?
leila: I can do the battlecard. Draft pitch: "Redwood gives consistent, predictable LLM inference — start on Hosted, move to Dedicated when you need SLA-backed throughput and data isolation." Keep it conversational.
marco: Suggest adding quick objections and counters: cost concerns, migration effort, and vendor lock.
kira: On KPIs for the pilot: conversion rate from registered partner leads, average deal size, and incremental pipeline influenced. Also track support tickets for Dedicated migrations.
leila: We9ll evaluate pilot at 12 weeks. If conversion > 15% and avg deal size uplift >20%, consider extending and increasing credit.
ops-bot: New doc uploaded -> https://redwood.co/docs/partners/pilot-2026
sam: Operations/coordination asks: 1) who runs weekly partner office hours? 2) where do we centralize regs + docs?
nowen: Partner ops will run office hours starting next Wed 11am PT. Centralized docs in /docs/partners and registration artifacts in SFDC attachments.
marco: Any channel discounts beyond co-sell credit for pilot?
leila: No additional channel discounts for pilot. Keep pricing consistent; co-sell credit is the incentive.
sam: One more 1: AE question about forecasting: do POCs count toward commit?
leila: No. POCs are not commit. Only signed subscription/POs count toward commit. Put POC amount in "influenced" category.
kira: Action items recap: 1) Leila 1: battlecard + SFDC field + pilot rules; 2) Nowen 1: SE handoff + terraform snippet; 3) Tara 1: Dedicated vs Hosted one-pager; 4) Partner Ops 1: weekly office hours + registration form tracking; 5) Sales Ops 1: quote template and calc sheet.
marco: I'll schedule a short sync to review the quote template with Eng Infra and Sales Ops.
leila: posting battlecard draft here soon. Will @ops and @sales when ready.
sam: Thanks everyone. Please react with :white_check_mark: when you9re done or flag blockers.
nowen: :white_check_mark: SE handoff PR opened.
tara: :white_check_mark: one-pager draft up for review.
leila: :white_check_mark: battlecard + SFDC field created.
ops-bot: Meeting note: Office hours recurring created -> https://calendar.redwood.co/event/partner-ops-office-hours
sam: Closing thread. Ping me if you want me on customer handoffs. :v:
